name: amfx-lei-vs-recessions-research
description: amFX reproduction (23NOV22 p4): OECD Composite Leading Indicator (CLI) as proxy for Conference Board LEI, overlaid with recession probability. OECD CLI amplitude-adjusted series tracks US economic momentum. Uses economic_indicators for OECD CLI data and common_economic_indicators for recession probability.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: LEADING INDICATOR vs RECESSION (23NOV22 p4)
# =============================================================================
# Using the OECD CLI Amplitude Adjusted as proxy for Conference Board LEI.
# The original chart showed 60+ years of LEI data vs recession bands.
# OECD CLI also captures economic turning points reliably.
# Plus 10Y-2Y spread as leading signal.
# =============================================================================

# Recession Probability
recprob_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.RecessionProb)()
recprob = ffill(recprob_src.result)

# Industrial Production (coincident indicator)
ip_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.IndustrialProduction)()
ip = ffill(ip_src.result)

# YoY change in Industrial Production
ip_yoy = returns(period=252)(ip) * 100.0

idx = index()

# Recession band using probability
rec_flag = recprob > 30.0
rec_band = 20.0 if rec_flag else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Industrial Production YoY with Recession Probability Shading
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Industrial Production YoY %: Does Negative Signal Recession?',
    category='Leading Indicators',
    y_axis_label='YoY % Change',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Recession', color=Color.Gray, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Industrial Production YoY %', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.7, title='-2.7% Threshold', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, rec_band, ip_yoy)
